company.shortDescription: Frame.io is a cloud-based video collaboration platform that allows users to upload source media and assets into private workspaces.
company.description:
Frame.io is a cloud-based video collaboration platform that allows users to upload source media and assets into private workspaces.

It is used by media companies to streamline their video review and collaboration process with teammates, clients, and a variety of stakeholders. It supports over over 1 million media professionals and companies by bringing together media and stakeholders in a single platform for efficient and intuitive collaboration.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based platform for storing, organizing, reviewing, approving, sharing, and presenting video, photo, design, document, and other creative assets.
productsAndServices.name: Frame.io

productsAndServices.description: An enterprise offering that provides scalable creative collaboration with multiple workspaces, centralized administration, advanced access controls, custom storage, security features, APIs, and dedicated support.
productsAndServices.name: Frame.io Enterprise

productsAndServices.description: A workflow that uploads camera-captured media directly to Frame.io during or immediately after production for remote access, organization, review, and collaboration.
productsAndServices.name: Frame.io Camera to Cloud

productsAndServices.description: A desktop application for uploading and downloading large files, folder structures, and entire projects between a computer and Frame.io while preserving organization.
productsAndServices.name: Frame.io Transfer App

productsAndServices.description: An integration included with select Adobe Creative Cloud subscriptions that provides Frame.io storage, collaboration, review, sharing, and Camera to Cloud capabilities within Adobe workflows.
productsAndServices.name: Frame.io for Adobe Creative Cloud

productsAndServices.description: API-based connectivity that lets organizations connect Frame.io with creative applications, storage systems, workflow tools, and custom software.
productsAndServices.name: Frame.io APIs and Integrations
